_note: Edit freely. 'threshold' is the market cap in USD at which a log unlocks on the site. Thresholds are story checkpoints, NOT price targets or predictions. Exactly one chapter should have "horizon": true; the meter measures the distance to it. Chapters unlock in order of threshold.

chapters.title: Departure
chapters.text: Mission log 000. Suit sealed. Oxygen: fine. Judgment: debatable. Ahead, a perfectly dark circle that every instrument calls a bad idea and nobody can stop looking at. The black hole is the chart. I'm going in.

chapters.title: Gravity Notices You
chapters.text: The pull is subtle at first. A little drift, a little faster each hour. Nothing dramatic. That's the whole trick: you don't feel the edge. You feel 'just one more look.'

chapters.title: Redshift
chapters.text: Light from the people behind me is stretching toward red. They're getting quieter, and further away. From in here, the old world looks like a sunset.

chapters.title: Time Dilation
chapters.text: My clock runs slow now, compared to everyone watching. To them I'm frozen at the edge. To me it's been a calm afternoon. Both are true. Physics is the original meme.

chapters.title: Spaghettification
chapters.text: Tidal forces stretch whatever can't hold together. Astronomers call it spaghettification. Paper hands call it 'selling the bottom.' Diamond hands call it someone else's problem.

chapters.title: The Point of No Return
chapters.text: This is the line. Past here, even light can't turn around. There's no announcement, just a quiet realization: we are the Crossed. The only way out is up. (That's lore, not a promise.)

chapters.title: Inside
chapters.text: Inside the horizon, 'forward' stops being a direction and becomes a time. Every map I brought is obsolete. Good thing I'm a meme and not a navigator.

chapters.title: Singularity
chapters.text: At the center, the math runs out. Nobody has made it here and filed a report. I'll keep logging anyway.
